# CyberGrid JavaScript SDK source

Source: https://github.com/ywateru/CyberGrid/tree/2bd6729c6bbee90ed2926410caca883a0a100890/sdk-js

`index.ts` is the official SDK source, formatted to match this repository. Original LICENSE and notices are retained alongside it. No new license or redistribution grant is inferred from public repository access; release approval must resolve the owner's distribution permission. The SDK handles discovery only. AnyWork's business encryption is implemented separately using clatterjs and Rust snow.
